overall_composition: dominant mechanism panel on the left with a compact evidence dashboard on the right
visual_hierarchy: mechanistic core → pathway/module expression summaries → culture/validation evidence

membrane_intracellular_rendering: intracellular pathway modules are embedded in the cell without membrane-level anatomy
material_rendering: no material emphasis; the cell itself is the principal scaffold
molecule_metabolite_rendering: DOM/electron/Sb species use compact circles, text labels and pathway nodes
arrow_connector_grammar: yellow/orange electron-flow cues are visually distinct from black biochemical arrows; panel divisions separate mechanism from evidence
palette: cool cyan/blue biological base with yellow electron accents plus orange/green/blue evidence bars
typography_labeling: small technical labels in the mechanism; panel letters and grouped headers organize the evidence side

lighting_shadow: minimal lighting; color is semantic rather than decorative

whitespace: moderate; open cytoplasmic background helps many arrows remain legible
